tools.name: ct600_filing_guide
tools.description: READ THIS FIRST. How to prepare a CT600 with this server: which companies qualify, the order to gather figures in, what the words mean (micro-entity, filleted accounts, the declaration), and which cases to refer to an accountant instead. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: lookup_uk_company
tools.description: Look up a UK company at Companies House by company number: name, status, registered office, next accounts period, and a quick fit check.

tools.name: check_ct600_eligibility
tools.description: Check whether a company fits this tool (micro-entity limits, single UK trade, no groups/R&D/gains/property). An overdrawn director loan is supported: the return carries a CT600A. Money in POUNDS.

tools.name: uk_company_late_filing_penalties
tools.description: Late filing penalties for a UK company's accounts (Companies House) and CT600 (HMRC): what is owed if filed on a given date, and the full schedule of dates when each penalty applies. Use with lookup_uk_company, which gives the accounts deadline. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD); filedOn defaults to today.

tools.name: estimate_uk_self_assessment
tools.description: Estimate one person's UK Self Assessment for one tax year (2025-26 or 2026-27): income tax on salary, dividends, self-employment and interest, Class 4, student loans, payments on account, and Class 1 National Insurance on a salary from the person's own company. Uses the same engine as A.X.E.L Filing

tools.name: uk_director_tax_year
tools.description: The director's whole year in one view: the company's corporation tax AND the director's own Self Assessment, side by side. tools.name: compute_ct600
tools.description: Compute the corporation tax position from figures (stateless, nothing stored): tax due, taxable profit, marginal relief, losses, CT600 box values.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "uk_director_tax_year" is 1332 chars, far longer than this server's median (257). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
